query:
SELECT id, title, category, status, queuePosition, createdAt
FROM quickfireChallenges
WHERE status IN ('queued', 'scheduled')
  AND (publishDate IS NULL OR publishDate <= '2026-03-23')
  AND (id, category) IN (
    SELECT MIN(id), category
    FROM quickfireChallenges
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'scheduled')
      AND (publishDate IS NULL OR publishDate <= '2026-03-23')
    GROUP BY category
  )
ORDER BY category;
